summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Advance Balance feature on GarlicLedger Pro (RN-Web on Expo). All 4 advance scenarios (A/B/C/D), the FIFO regression case, and the Day Report advance stats + PDF export were exercised on the live preview URL with a freshly cleared IndexedDB. All arithmetic matches the spec exactly, no uncaught JS errors, only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver).

issues: Icon name 'wallet-minus' does not exist in MaterialCommunityIcons -> rendered as '?' glyph in Advance History rows of type 'used'. Fixed by testing agent (changed to 'cash-minus').

REG_fifo_unaffected.note: Own-bill payment stays on own bill; no phantom advance.

day_report.export_pdf: window.print called successfully (1 invocation), no JS errors

critical_code_review_comments: ledger.ts is a clean, pure engine — good separation of concerns and FIFO invariants; keeps rounding to 2 decimals with EPS tolerance.
Fixed: customer/[id].tsx used MaterialCommunityIcons name 'wallet-minus' which is not in the glyphmap -> rendered as '?'. Changed to 'cash-minus'. Consider auditing other icon names similarly.
sale.tsx correctly no longer clamps received to total; sale-advance preview and sale-status update reactively.
receive-payment/[customerId].tsx shows receive-advance preview correctly for overpay.
Day Report stats grid now includes Advance Added / Advance Used derived from history entries dated on the selected day — verified visually and via innerText.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI in a freshly cleared IndexedDB: AdvTestA (1 sale), AdvTestB (2 sales), AdvTestC (2 sales), AdvTestD (1 sale + 1 payment), RegTest (2 sales). Data lives only inside the Playwright browser context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is production-ready. Key testids used: sale-customer, sale-quantity, sale-price, sale-received, sale-total, sale-status, sale-advance, sale-save, customer-pending, customer-advance, customer-advance-card, bill-row-<id>, advance-row-<id>, customer-receive-payment, receive-amount, receive-advance, confirm-payment, dashboard-hero-press, day-report-screen, day-report-export-pdf, tab-home/tab-sale/tab-more, more-customers. Field component places data-testid on the TextInput itself (NOT a wrapper), so selectors are '[data-testid="sale-customer"]' with no ' input' subselector. Navigation between screens works reliably via page.goto to /sale, /, and /customer/<id>; tab bar only renders on tabs routes so clicking tab-sale while on customer profile times out. For PDF export intercept window.print BEFORE clicking export.
rca of the issue: N/A - only one minor cosmetic icon issue found and fixed.
